summary: Uninstall removes executables copied by first-run setup from an extracted archive, and local service reset skips an absent replication unit.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rebuilding changes.

schema.detail: Setup uses the existing install.json file list consumed by uninstall; no graph schema changes.

rules.detail: No rules or fleet transition changes.

compatibility.detail: When setup copies st3, st and pty into ~/.local/bin, it records their absolute paths in the user's st3 data directory. Managed executables kept in place and --install false are not adopted.

downtime.detail: No automatic daemon restart or fleet downtime is added.

manual.detail: st uninstall can remove files recorded by future setup installs. Earlier unrecorded installs still require manual binary removal.

recovery.detail: The install record follows XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share and is saved atomically. Missing replication service files are skipped during stop, restart and uninstall; failures stopping installed units are reported.
